segments.title: Pepito Station Cold-Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on as executive producer, identifying as the dog that produces the show.

segments.title: News Desk Opening & Schedule Announcement
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast, announces a short streaming week (Monday and Wednesday only) due to Chicago Sketchfest appearance Saturday, and banters with Pepito about work, retirement, and Peter Gibbon's organ harvesting.

segments.title: Hype Train Social Studies Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the broadcast as a 'social studies teacher' named Chong, delivering freestyle raps about Chinese fates, Macy's Dark Age, and sub acknowledgments while Case remains uncharacteristically agreeable.

segments.title: Anthropic IPO Coverage & Engagement Reveal
segments.notes: Case covers Anthropic's $2T IPO prospectus with $42B losses, then reveals he and Kendall are engaged after accidentally leaking the news in the Cream Team Discord two weeks prior.

segments.title: Chat News & Harry Hardy Raid
segments.notes: Case and Peter Gibbon cover Laughing Cow mascot rebrand, Flock Safety CEO's home marked as public toilet, wrestler Pack's death, and a Burbank theater pepper spraying; Harry Hardy raids the stream at 41:02.

segments.title: UPI News Minute with Ben Hooper
segments.notes: Ben Hooper delivers the UPI All News Minute covering Fat Bear Week voting, a 78-year-old Fortnite streamer Guinness record, and promotes UPI's YouTube channel.

segments.title: DJ C4: Harry Hardy Trap Beat Songwriting Session
segments.notes: DJ C4 produces a 'Dirty Harry Trap Beat' track for raider Harry Hardy, incorporating chat lyrics, Peter Gibbon vocals with pitch-shifting and auto-tune, and extensive mixing.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Skeleton Munch vs. Rotting Corpse Crumb Halloween Debate
segments.notes: Skeleton Munch and Crum debate who makes the better Halloween decoration; Munch argues his permanent skeleton form beats Crum's temporary zombie phase from last year, complete with skeleton puns and lore callbacks.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Tasty
segments.notes: Case signs off promoting Wednesday's stream and Chicago Sketchfest Saturday, raids Tasty, and exchanges final words with Peter Gibbon.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors truncated Monday broadcast, announces engagement to Kendall, remains uncharacteristically agreeable during Hype Train derailment.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers station cold-open sign-on, banters about cigarette sandwiches and work during news opening.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Commandeers broadcast as 'Chong' the social studies teacher, delivers hour-long freestyle rap derailment with sub acknowledgments.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Interjects throughout broadcast, discusses organ harvesting, participates in DJ C4 session with pitch-shifted vocals, debates engagement etiquette.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: recurring. Appears in Munch & Crum debate as former zombie, argues his rotting corpse form was superior Halloween decoration to Munch's skeleton.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: recurring. Debates as permanent skeleton (since Sept 7), claims superiority over Crum's temporary zombie phase, delivers skeleton puns.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell and Kendall engaged; news leaked in Cream Team Discord two weeks prior, confirmed via Instagram post [32:45].
Case streaming only Monday and Wednesday this week due to Chicago Sketchfest appearance Saturday 9 PM [08:42].
Munch confirms permanent skeleton form since September 7, 2026 incident [1:27:57].
Crum was a zombie last summer (2025) per debate reference to 'zombie Crumb' imagery [1:30:33].
Harry Hardy raided the stream at 41:02, prompting DJ C4 songwriting session.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a truncated Monday broadcast ahead of Chicago Sketchfest, featuring a prolonged Hype Train derailment as a social studies teacher, an engagement announcement with Kendall after a Discord leak, a DJ C4 songwriting session for raider Harry Hardy, and a Munch & Crum Halloween decoration debate between Skeleton Munch and Zombie Crum.
